ads.headline: Lead gen CPMs rising; $25 daily budgets need tighter audience targeting
actions: Segment service area by zip code, test 3-5 micro-audiences instead of broad radius
Switch to Advantage+ Shopping with conversion API tracking to compete on quality score
Cap daily budget at $15 for cold audiences, reserve $10 for retargeting warm leads
ads.source: r/FacebookAds weekly discussion threads + Google Trends lead generation spike

creative.headline: Can't find this insight? Your ads are hemorrhaging money
actions: "I found the #1 reason plumbers waste $500/week on Meta ads..."

Screen record your Meta Ads Manager showing a poorly segmented audience or low-quality lead filter. Walk through: (1) The mistake most local service owners make, (2) The specific setting to fix it, (3) Before/after cost-per-lead comparison. Why it works: Service owners obsess over wasting ad spend — this speaks directly to their pain point and positions you as the expert who knows their backend.

Avoid posting generic motivational content about "mindset" or "hustle" — local service business owners ignore aspirational content and only engage with tactical, money-saving tips they can apply immediately.
creative.source: Historical pattern analysis: Zero trending data this week suggests low engagement baseline — pivot to utility-first content that solves immediate problems rather than trend-chasing

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
